description:
The Huffy Motoric Folding E-Bike makes it easier than ever to fit cycling into your everyday routine. Its lightweight folding aluminum frame stores neatly in apartments, offices, RVs, or vehicle trunks, giving you the freedom to ride wherever life takes you. Whether you're commuting across town or exploring new paths on the weekend, the Motoric is built to keep up with your lifestyle.
A powerful 350W rear hub motor paired with a removable 36V battery delivers smooth pedal assist and throttle power whenever you need it. Hills feel less intimidating, headwinds become manageable, and longer rides feel more enjoyable. Shimano 6-speed shifting helps you find the perfect cadence, while front and rear mechanical disc brakes provide reliable stopping confidence in changing conditions.
The Motoric comes equipped with practical features that make every ride more convenient. Full fenders help keep you cleaner on wet roads, while the integrated rear rack is ready for bags, groceries, or daily essentials. An LED headlight, kickstand, and bell add everyday functionality, creating an e-bike that's equally comfortable handling weekday commutes or spontaneous weekend escapes. Fold it, store it, and get back on the road whenever adventure calls.
